arguments.question: How should Temple of Two dogfood Claude Code Agent View and /goal against live T2HELIX work without creating parallel-agent drift or unsafe unattended writes?
arguments.context: Opened from the 2026-05-24 OpenAI bridge conversation after Anthony asked to stay current with Anthropic’s Claude Code releases. Suggested first adoption pass: upgrade/verify Claude Code 2.1.139+, open `claude agents`, and dispatch bounded background sessions for T2HELIX v0.0.6 credential redaction, Grok Ring 2 MCP annotation audit, and Stack toolkit_grammar() implementation sketch. The test should preserve verify-before-declare discipline: each session needs measurable /goal conditions, clean git status, and human review before merge or Stack commit.
